name: SSO Authentication
description: Lets users sign in to Jellyfin through an OpenID Connect or SAML identity provider such as Authelia, authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID or Kanidm. Accounts are created on first sign-in, and the provider's roles can decide who may sign in, who is an administrator, and which libraries and Live TV each account can use. Continues 9p4's SSO-Auth plugin under its own ID: remove that plugin first, and this one picks up its providers and linked accounts.
overview: Sign in to Jellyfin with OpenID Connect or SAML
